title: Fix formatBytes for 0, negative, and >1024 TB inputs
summary: Fixes bug #402: formatBytes helper now handles 0-byte files (returned "NaN undefined"), negative values, and very large numbers (≥1024 TB).
Adds defensive checks for non-finite input, returns "0 B" for zero, and clamps unit index to prevent array overflow.
Display-only change affecting FileRow and UploadDialog; no API or storage impact.
